title: house-rules configuration
description: Configuration for the house-rules plugin, stored in .house-rules.json at the repository root. Put every rule under the "rules" object; rule ids at the top level are rejected. A rule value is a severity string, [severity], or [severity, options].

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation. Has no effect on rule behaviour.

rules.description: Map of rule id to rule setting. Rules you omit keep their defaults. Known rules: commit-message, comment-density, artifact-structure. The id stray-artifacts is a deprecated alias for artifact-structure.

commit-message.description: Checks commit messages against a style preset. Severity can only be "error": a commit that violates the preset is rejected. Use options to choose the preset; the default preset is handbook.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a commit whose message violates the preset. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a commit whose message violates the preset. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for commit-message. Only "preset" is supported.

preset.description: Commit style to enforce. "handbook": subject starts with an imperative verb and is at most 50 characters; no commit body is allowed. "conventional": subject follows type(scope): description with a known type (feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert), at most 72 characters. "subject-only": use when the repository already has its own subject convention (for example commitlint); the subject format is not checked and only the message structure is.

comment-density.description: Limits how many comment lines a change adds relative to the code lines it adds. The cap is fixed at 5 comment lines per 100 added lines. Severity can only be "error". Use it to keep code free of narrating or redundant comments.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that adds too many comment lines. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that adds too many comment lines. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for comment-density. This rule has no options; the object must be empty.

artifact-structure.description: Flags stray files a change leaves behind: coexisting synonym directory pairs (doc and docs, test and tests, script and scripts, util and utils, lib and libs) and root scratch files (test-*.js, *.bak, tmp*, scratch*). Severity can only be "error". Options hold a doc-type manifest (govern, types, forbidden); with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

oneOf.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.

prefixItems.description: Severity. "error" rejects a change that leaves stray artifacts. No other severity is accepted for this rule.
Options for artifact-structure: the doc-type manifest. All keys are optional; with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.

govern.description: Glob patterns for the paths the doc-type manifest governs.

types.description: Doc types keyed by type id. A file whose path matches a type's generates template is a document of that type.

tier.description: Lifecycle tier of documents of this type.

generates.description: Path template for documents of this type, for example docs/research/{name:kebab}.md. Placeholders are {name} or {name:kebab|camel|pascal}.

description.description: What documents of this type are for.

instruction.description: Instruction shown to the author when the type applies.

template.description: Inline starter text for new documents of this type, or null for none.

frontmatter.description: JSON Schema for the document frontmatter. Stored, not validated.

headings.description: Headings documents of this type carry.

forbidden.description: Path patterns that must not be created, each with the place to put the file instead.

pattern.description: Glob for forbidden paths. ** matches any depth, * one path segment, ? one character.

redirect.description: Where the file belongs instead. May contain {slug}.

stray-artifacts.description: Flags stray files a change leaves behind: coexisting synonym directory pairs (doc and docs, test and tests, script and scripts, util and utils, lib and libs) and root scratch files (test-*.js, *.bak, tmp*, scratch*). Severity can only be "error". Options hold a doc-type manifest (govern, types, forbidden); with no types the rule keeps the legacy stray-file check.
